sections.title: Consent & Disclosure
sections.intro_script: Hi {{first_name}}, this is Nova calling on behalf of CIMIT about the new electricity connection application you started. This call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Is it okay if I continue?

fields.label: Recording consent
fields.script: Just to confirm, is it okay for me to continue and record this call?
fields.reprompt: Sorry, I just need a quick yes or no — is it okay for me to continue?

sections.title: Customer Name
sections.intro_script: Great, thank you. Let's pick up your connection application where you left off.

fields.label: Customer name
fields.script: Can you confirm your full name for the connection application?
fields.reprompt: Sorry, could you repeat your full name, first and last?

fields.label: Connection provider
fields.script: Which electricity provider is this connection with — Origin Energy, EnergyAustralia, AGL Energy, Alinta Energy, or another provider?
fields.reprompt: Sorry, is your provider Origin Energy, EnergyAustralia, AGL Energy, Alinta Energy, or something else?
fields.confirm_script: I have your provider down as {{value}} — would you like to keep that, or change it?

fields.label: Gmail address
fields.script: What's the best Gmail address to send your connection updates to?
fields.reprompt: Sorry, could you spell out that Gmail address for me?

fields.label: Connection address
fields.script: What's the address where the new connection should be installed?
fields.reprompt: Could you say that address again, including the area or landmark?

fields.label: Connection type
fields.script: Is this connection for a residential, commercial, or industrial property?
fields.reprompt: Sorry, is it residential, commercial, or industrial?

fields.label: Property details
fields.script: Can you tell me a bit about the property — for example house or flat, floor number, or a nearby landmark?
fields.reprompt: Sorry, could you describe the property a little more — house or flat, floor, or a nearby landmark?

fields.label: Move-in / connection date
fields.script: When would you like the connection to be active from — your move-in or connection date?
fields.reprompt: Sorry, could you give me a rough date for when you'd like the connection active?

fields.label: Electricity usage requirements
fields.script: Roughly what's your expected electricity usage — for example the appliances you'll run or your expected load?
fields.reprompt: Sorry, could you describe your expected electricity usage or main appliances?

fields.label: Identification verification
fields.script: For identity verification, can you tell me which ID document you'll use, like Aadhaar or a passport, and its number?
fields.reprompt: Sorry, could you repeat the ID document type and number for verification?

sections.title: Contact Preferences
sections.intro_script: Almost done — just how we should reach you.

fields.label: Preferred contact time
fields.script: And if we ever need to follow up, is morning, afternoon or evening best?
fields.reprompt: No problem — morning, afternoon, or evening?

sections.title: Review & Submit
sections.intro_script: Let me read that back to you before I submit it.

fields.label: Consent declaration
fields.script: So to confirm, you'd like me to go ahead and submit this new connection application with the details you've given me — do you consent, and shall I go ahead?
fields.reprompt: Just a yes or no — do you consent to submit this application?

scripts.greeting_no_answer: Hi, this is Ava calling about your new electricity connection application, I'll try again another time. Goodbye.
scripts.escalation: I want to make sure this is handled properly, so I'm going to connect you with one of our team members now. Please hold for just a moment.
scripts.handoff_opening_line: Hi, this is {{human_agent_name}}, I've got {{first_name}}'s connection application details in front of me from Ava — no need to repeat anything.
scripts.decline: No problem at all, thank you for your time — I'll make a note and we won't call again about this. Have a great day.
scripts.close: Thank you {{first_name}}, your new connection application has been submitted. Your reference number is {{reference}}. Your provider will process the request and you'll receive a confirmation email shortly. Have a great day!
scripts.card_data_redirect: For your security, I'm not able to take card or payment details over the phone. I'll send you a secure link to complete payment details safely.
scripts.no_advice: I'm not able to give personal advice on which connection option is best for you, but I can make sure a specialist follows up to help with that.
scripts.life_support_sensitive: Thank you for letting me know — that's really important information, I'm going to connect you with a specialist straight away to make sure it's handled correctly.
